svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Northern brings the aurora to your wrist: green, teal and violet ribbons move slowly
over snow-capped mountains and a still lake that reflects them. A hairline Inter Tight clock floats above the scene
for a calm, premium read, and the complication suggests stepping outside or shows your documentary's progress. Motion
is deliberately slow to stay restful, and always-on drops to thin grey type on true black.
368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
